description: This file defines the AssetRepository class for handling CRUD operations, queries, and integrity checks related to 'Assets' in a data asset management system. It interacts with a PostgreSQL database via Npgsql and includes methods for creating, reading, updating, soft-deleting assets, and managing related child resources like status logs, additional IDs, properties, mappings, and input parameters.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations, validation, and query functions for assets and their related entities in the database.

classes.name: AssetRepository.EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Exception class thrown when a specific asset entity is not found during validation or retrieval.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database and returns its DTO.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches an asset by its ID, excluding soft-deleted records.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset record and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assets based on optional filters, excluding soft-deleted records.

methods.name: PermitEuIdExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if a permit EU ID already exists among non-deleted assets, optionally excluding a specific asset ID.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if an asset with the specified ID exists and is not soft-deleted.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of an asset and cascades deletions to related records, maintaining transactional integrity.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific input parameter belongs to a given asset.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks if a throughput equation is linked to a specified input parameter.

methods.name: WouldParentInputMappingCreateCycleAsync
methods.description: Detects if adding a parent input mapping would introduce a cycle in the hierarchy.

methods.name: ReportingAttributeCombinationExistsAsync
methods.description: Validates the uniqueness of a reporting attribute combination under an asset.

methods.name: GetLatestStatusToDateAsync
methods.description: Fetches the latest status-to date for an asset, used for validation of status chronology.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific status log entry under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific status log entry.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates a new additional asset ID entry associated with an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional IDs for a specific asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific additional asset ID by its ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset property record.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists properties related to an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset property by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific asset property record.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific control device mapping by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing control device mapping.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter for an asset.
